boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten admission-free outings for Emmanuel students and friends, from nearby art museums to public galleries, library architecture, historic collections, and an arboretum walk.

cards.title: Compare Favorites at the MFA
cards.subtitle: A free museum outing for Emmanuel students
cards.notes: Bring your Emmanuel student ID, choose one gallery together, then regroup to compare the artwork each person would take home.
cards.short_summary: Turn Emmanuel’s museum access into a low-pressure group art afternoon near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel College states that the Museum of Fine Arts is 0.5 miles from campus and free for Emmanuel students.
cards.access_notes: Free admission is limited to Emmanuel students; bring a valid Emmanuel student ID and confirm the museum's current entry procedure before leaving.

cards.title: Circle the Gardner Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Student admission covered through Emmanuel
cards.notes: Bring your Emmanuel ID, walk the galleries in pairs, and meet beside the courtyard to trade one detail everyone nearly overlooked.
cards.short_summary: Use Emmanuel’s student benefit for a shared look at art, architecture, and the central garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel College states that its students receive free access to the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for Emmanuel students. Bring a valid student ID and check the museum's current reservation procedure before visiting.

cards.title: Trade Takes at MAAM
cards.subtitle: An always-free contemporary art meetup
cards.notes: Reserve free tickets, pick one work that starts a conversation, and compare interpretations outside after everyone finishes the galleries.
cards.short_summary: Gather around changing contemporary exhibitions at a museum that charges no admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The MassArt Art Museum describes itself as always free and provides free advance tickets.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free, but advance ticket reservations are encouraged. Indoor programming is paused during summer 2026, so verify reopening before going.

cards.title: Take the Library Art Tour
cards.subtitle: Free architecture and artwork in Copley Square
cards.notes: Open the library’s mobile guide, follow the 30-minute audio route together, and pause in the courtyard to compare favorite rooms.
cards.short_summary: Explore the Central Library’s murals, sculpture, and architecture without booking a paid tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Public Library says the Central Library is free and open to the public and provides a free self-guided mobile audio tour.
cards.source_title: Art & Architecture Tours at the Central Library
cards.access_notes: The Central Library is free and open to the public during operating hours. Groups larger than 30 must register in advance.

cards.title: Pick an Artwork Conversation Starter
cards.subtitle: Free galleries open to every visitor
cards.notes: Pair off for one gallery, choose a work that deserves discussion, and reunite in the Calderwood Courtyard to share your choices.
cards.short_summary: Build a group outing around three Harvard art collections with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard University states that the Harvard Art Museums are free and open to all visitors Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free for all visitors Tuesday through Sunday; check current hours and closure notices before traveling to Cambridge.

cards.entity_name: Harvard Museum of the Ancient Near East
cards.title: Decode an Ancient Gallery Together
cards.subtitle: Free admission to a public Harvard museum
cards.notes: Choose one object per person, read its label closely, and meet at the end of the gallery to connect the objects into a shared story.
cards.short_summary: Make a collaborative history exercise from a compact, admission-free museum visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard University says the Harvard Museum of the Ancient Near East is open to the public and free of admission Sunday through Friday.
cards.access_notes: General admission is free, and the museum welcomes the public Sunday through Friday; verify current daily hours before visiting.

cards.title: Spot the Strangest Scientific Instrument
cards.subtitle: A free science-history gallery challenge
cards.notes: Have everyone nominate the most unfamiliar instrument, inspect its label, and explain to the group what problem it was designed to solve.
cards.short_summary: Turn Harvard’s free instrument collection into a friendly object-identification challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Museums of Science & Culture lists general admission to the Collection of Historical Scientific Instruments as free.
cards.source_title: Visit All Four Harvard Museums of Science & Culture
cards.access_notes: General admission is free. The collection is listed as open Sunday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.; check for closures before departure.

cards.title: Walk a Living Collection
cards.subtitle: A free outdoor plant tour with friends
cards.notes: Pick a landscape section on the arboretum map, photograph three labeled plants, and compare your finds at the end of the route.
cards.short_summary: Use the labeled living collection for a social walk that needs neither tickets nor purchases.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard University states that the Arnold Arboretum is open daily and free for all to explore.
cards.access_notes: The landscape is open daily and free for everyone to explore. Check weather, seasonal notices, and gate information before setting out.

cards.title: Meet Around Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Free galleries in MIT’s Wiesner Building
cards.notes: Start in separate galleries, select one piece that raises a question, and reconvene in the atrium to discuss everyone’s picks.
cards.short_summary: Use the List Center’s changing exhibitions as the setting for an admission-free Cambridge meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: The MIT List Visual Arts Center states that it is free and open to all visitors.
cards.source_title: Visit | MIT List Visual Arts Center
cards.access_notes: The List Center is free and open to all Tuesday through Sunday. Confirm current gallery hours and exhibition transitions before visiting.

cards.title: Share a Slow-Looking Session
cards.subtitle: Seven-day free public access at Boston College
cards.notes: Set a five-minute timer at one artwork, write down what each person notices, and compare observations before exploring the next room.
cards.short_summary: Try structured slow looking together inside Boston College’s free public art museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston College’s McMullen Museum states that it is open to the public free of charge seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Public admission is free seven days a week. Review the museum calendar before visiting because gallery availability changes with exhibitions and events.
